thread:
priya_cs: Quick sync — Northpoint week0 telemetry/IAM/KMS check. @lina_se can you confirm ingress NAT and audit log forwarding? Also noticed no audit events in last 72h, flagging renewal risk. /cc @marcel_customer

lina_se: On it. Quick Q — are they using our forwarded Splunk pack or a self-managed SIEM?

marcel_customer: Self-managed Splunk (splunk-np-prod). We asked for HEC token last week, still pending from infra.

tom_sre: If HEC token missing we can forward temporarily to logs-proxy. Need firewall to allow 10.2.4.8:8088 from their egress. @priya_cs do we have consent?

priya_cs: They approved limited egress to our proxy in the onboarding doc (see onboarding doc link). I'll re-share the signed appendix.

deploy-bot: ticket #CS-44321 created -> Integrations: splunk-hec-token follow-up

lina_se: KMS note: their account doesn't have a CMK alias set for redwood usage. For private mode we require a customer-managed CMK with rotation policy. @marcel_customer are they okay with AWS KMS or do they want CloudHSM?

marcel_customer: AWS KMS preferred. We're blocked waiting for the IAM role creation: 'redwood-onboard-role'. We've pasted the permissions doc in the ticket.

lina_se: OK. For IAM we need a role with sts:AssumeRole and kms decrypt/generate. Example policy snippet (please paste ARN once created):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["sts:AssumeRole", "kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```
priya_cs: FYI on renewal: if we can't validate audit logs during the 14-day trial window we'll mark this as an observability risk and AE outreach will be triggered. I set risk:medium for now.

marcel_customer: ARN pasted: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-onboard-role
HEC token still pending; CCing infra (infra-np@northpoint.com).

lina_se: Thanks. @tom_sre — can you whitelist 10.2.4.8:8088 in proxy ACL for their VPC and run an egress validation? I need a curl result to confirm ingestion.

tom_sre: Adding to ACL now. I'll run a quick curl from their bastion once they confirm bastion access. Ping me when bastion creds are posted.

marcel_customer: Bastion access rotated and key uploaded to secure share: https://files.redwood.example/shares/np-bastion-key :lock:

deploy-bot: deploy-checklist: ingress-egress-sanity -> pass pending curl from bastion

lina_se: After curl success I'll validate Splunk events ingestion and KMS key policy. Then we'll close the telemetry gap. ETA: today EOD.

priya_cs: :thumbsup: I'll update the customer health dashboard and keep renewal-risk:medium until confirmation.
